infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This dispatch app uses your location to calculate delivery routes, assign nearby drivers, and display live order tracking to customers and dispatchers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: This dispatch app uses background location while drivers are on duty so dispatchers and customers can track active deliveries in real time during turn-by-turn navigation.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: This dispatch app uses your camera so drivers can capture Proof of Delivery photos at dropoff.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This dispatch app accesses your photo library so drivers can attach Proof of Delivery images to completed orders.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow active background location updates while drivers are on duty.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow drivers to capture Proof of Delivery photos at dropoff.
plugins.photosPermission: Allow drivers to attach Proof of Delivery images from your photo library.
